headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: RUS (11)

summary: Charles Leclerc won the United States Grand Prix from P4 on the grid, 8.6s ahead of Carlos Sainz, with Max Verstappen completing the podium.
George Russell made the biggest climb, from P20 to P6.
Esteban Ocon had a day to forget, dropping from P12 to P18.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised RUS (5 second time penalty), GAS (5 second time penalty), TSU (5 second time penalty) and NOR (5 second time penalty).
There were 23 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 57 points over Lando Norris.
